working_definition: Author type 'LLPC1' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.

justification: 'LLPC1' is FBbt:00058227 'lobula-lobula plate columnar neuron LLPC1', which has no immature form in FBbt; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so the most specific ancestor with an immature form is used: FBbt:00053539 'immature adult optic lobe neuron' (as for Kurmangaliyev 2020 early clusters).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lobula-lobula plate columnar neuron that receives input from around 5-10 columns of lobula layer 4 and around 10 columns of lobula plate layer 1, with additional postsynapses in lobula plate layers 2-3 (Isaacson, 2019; Davis et al., 2020; Nern et al., 2025). It remains ipsilateral and sends output to the posterior lateral protocerebrum (Dorkenwald et al., 2024; Schlegel et al., 2024). It is highly sensitive to front-to-back motion on the ipsilateral eye (Isaacson, 2019). It is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020). There are around 100-120 of these cells on each side (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053539 'immature adult optic lobe neuron' (broad match).
